factions.name: ARES LOGISTICS GUILD
factions.tagline: FREIGHT, FUEL AND THE ROADS BETWEEN

detail.description: The guild owns every viable freight lane in the basin. They pay reliably and inspect everything twice.
detail.history: Chartered by the first colony council to keep the pads open. Their orange plate is the only colour allowed on a landing apron.
perks: Fuel reserve refills at any guild pad

factions.name: HELLFORGE SYNDICATE
factions.tagline: ROUGH PARTS, PROVEN IN THE OPEN

detail.description: An independent forge that outfits the crawler crews the guild will not touch. Loud, cheap, and surprisingly durable.
detail.history: Started as a salvage ring around the Hecate crash sites. Still refuses to register a corporate seal.
perks: Repair bays open outside guild hours

factions.name: SOLARIS CARTEL
factions.tagline: THE SUN ALWAYS GETS ITS CUT

detail.description: Orbital brokers who sell parts that never officially entered the colony. Their catalogue is the only source of legendary frames.
detail.history: Filed a sanction in the first cycle and never lost an appeal.

factions.name: MERIDIAN SURVEY CORPS
factions.tagline: THE MAP ENDS WHERE WE STOP WALKING

detail.description: The explorers who chart the ice veins and storm fronts the guild needs but cannot reach. Membership is earned in the field.
detail.history: Founded after the second expedition lost its primary survey team to a basin storm.

factions.name: DUST RUNNER UNION
factions.tagline: ALL PADS OPEN TO ANY CREW

detail.description: A crew cooperative that keeps the outer routes open. Nothing is free, but nothing is refused either.
detail.history: Built from shuttle mechanics who walked off the first pad dispute and set up their own runway.
